sentences: The TDP on your CPU box is not how much power it uses.
It tells cooler makers how much heat to plan for at base speed.
So Intel now lists two figures.
The Core i9-14900K has a base power of 125 watts, but a max turbo power of 253 watts.
The Ryzen 7 7700X is rated at 105 watts TDP.
Its power limit, called PPT, is 142 watts.
So size your cooler and power supply on the turbo or PPT figure, not the small one.
